title: pool build can rebuild one row or one section without resampling the rest
goal: benchmarks.py pool build takes a row id or a kind and rewrites only those rows, as scenario_built produces them, leaving the other sections as committed, so a fix to one scenario row (ST-keicy7gn, where a full build resampled offkb, gap, cites, decision and snippet after kb drift and the worker hand-edited the row) goes through the tool
